analysis: Offline saved-record tournament diagnostics; no API requests
optimum_definition: Any candidate tied for minimum saved runtime in that workload test pool; not all source schedules
advancement_definition: At least one test-pool optimum appears in the final question; only two-round cases are interpreted as round-0 elimination
limitations: Per-question probabilities are comparable only within their own question.
Elimination attribution uses recorded rankings and does not establish the counterfactual final choice if the optimum had advanced.
Probability ties can affect saved within-question ordering; the chosen candidate is ranked first.
No original prepared shards or request payloads were supplied; only saved records were inspected.
Option-count bins differ in round and workload composition; these are descriptive comparisons, not a controlled candidate-count ablation.
